description: Figure 6(a) illustrates the distribution of self-reflection statistics across different stages of training, specifically focusing on Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) data. The horizontal axis represents the training stage, labeled as “0%”, “20%”, “40%”, “60%”, “80%”, and “100%”, indicating percentage completion of the training data, and is a categorical axis. The vertical axis is labeled “Count” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 16000, with tick marks at 2000-unit intervals.  The chart consists of a single bar for each training stage. The bars are colored light blue and their heights correspond to the count of self-reflection statistics. The “0%” stage has a bar with a height of approximately 14333, while the “100%” stage has a bar with a height of approximately 10927.  The bars generally decrease in height from “0%” to “100%”, though not in a strictly monotonic fashion. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations. The bars are sorted sequentially based on the percentage of training data completion.
